plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner flow: brand lockup, then a large bottle, then headline and subhead, ending on the CTA at the right, so the eye travels brand, product, message, action.
A full-height bottle anchors the left, next to one left-aligned editorial column (logo above the headline and subhead, all sharing one left edge), with the CTA alone on the right.
A symmetric triptych: the large headline block on the left, the bottle as the centred focal point, and the brand logo stacked over the CTA on the right, a brand-and-action sign-off.
